correctness.rationale: All quantifiers n>=1, a,b,c in a fixed n+1 Gödel chain, and four weak-Heyting axioms are explicitly stated. Consequent isotonicity/antecedent antitonicity and C3 prove the adjacent-edge minimum normal form, and any edge vector independently satisfies C1--C4. The box is the suffix minimum of these independent parameters; the backward recurrence gives each factor and proves binomial and 2^n counts. The maximum and n=1 boundary are included. Independent table brute force n=2 (all 3^9 operations) and checks n=1..5 validate formulas; computations are not universal proof.
